scope: Independent JS and JSDOM only; no browser, server, socket, network, source edits, layout, or native keyboard behavior claimed.
source: GitHub 7f80cee3c408a276d89ca9f2ae27bca592ee9cc9 plus parent-approved local denseValues fix

checks.name: Composition definition and finite nine-cell/four-piece design are correctly scoped
Every field rejects own getters and inherited fields without accessor invocation or writes
Dense-array guards reject sparse, inherited index, own accessors, extra and symbol keys before writes
Inherited iterator accessors in composition cells, original and undo are rejected without calls or saved-data mutation
Both construction stages reject inherited iterator and some accessors without calls or saved-data mutation
Ordinary invalid closures and cross-route composition placement cannot overwrite saved progress
Reachable edit/reason/undo/revise transitions, original copy and cloned snapshot isolation
Ordinary v24 construction and exploration states retain their exact semantics under v25
Version 1–4 old ordinary snapshots load/save without deleting old proposal fields
v24 rollback cannot interpret composition but preserves raw bytes; v25 recovers it
Two stale composition sessions block overwrite/deletion until explicit reload
Queued coordinated save captures isolated composition arrays before lock acquisition
UI direct studio route has scoped labels, native controls, stable focus and optional no-edit close
UI pause/reload restores undo, original, edit, intent clearing and finish/restart boundaries
Original, composition and exploration routes retain independent content and pause state
UI v24 rollback protects current v25 record and upgraded reload restores composition
UI stale tab conflict preserves rival composition until explicit reload

observations.summary: Composition validation enforces closure prerequisites but does not reject every UI-unreachable combination: page 0 with a non-null reason, or page 2 with non-null undo and hint=true are accepted.
observations.boundary: Shipped UI transitions never produce these combinations. This concerns malformed-snapshot completeness, not an observed normal-flow failure.
